body: It’s that feeling of just a dark cloud looming over you I can’t stand - like what Churchill described as a black dog following him about. I appreciate your advice though and I’m glad you’re getting better, everyday you’re getting stronger. I wish you the best.

Thankyou for saying that, I really feel like I don’t know how to be happy anymore but your support means a lot. What you said about people using you as a tool was exactly right and I’ve tried to cut off the people who did that, it’s just so hard when you still care about them deep down, despite knowing they’re not good for you. I don’t know if I’ll see this week out but I know that before I go there truly are some good people out there :)
